name: ScanNet
description: An RGB-D video dataset of indoor scenes with reconstructed 3D surfaces, camera poses, and semantic annotations for 3D scene understanding. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Dai, A., Chang, A. X., Savva, M., Halber, M., Funkhouser, T., & Nießner, M. (2017). ScanNet: Richly-annotated 3D reconstructions of indoor scenes. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 5828–5839. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2017.261
